Attached is the first-pass offer for Elena Rossi (Senior Infra Program Manager). We captured the verbal at $180k base + 12k signing bonus + 0.20% equity (4-yr, 1-yr cliff) and the comp band guidance from People is Band 5 Level 3.

Subject: Re: Draft offer for Elena Rossi — comp band and start options

Thanks, Priyom — quick notes inline and then a short list of redlines I need HR to consider.

Inline summary:
- Base: $180,000 OK (meets band).
- Signing bonus: 12k OK, request pay-over-30-days rather than lump sum (helps budgeting).
- Equity: 0.20% OK, but add clear vesting start date tied to her first payroll date and add one-sentence on prorated grant if start > first month of quarter. 
- Relocation: support remote start. Offer relocation stipend (max $6,000) conditional on in-office relocation within 9 months. No gross-up.

Redlines for the doc (please incorporate):
1) Replace "Start date: TBD" with options: 2026-05-10 or 2026-06-01. Indicate "preferred start: 2026-05-10; flexible per candidate."
2) For signing bonus: clause to specify repayment if candidate leaves within 12 months pro rata rather than full repayment.
3) Equity language: add clause: "If start date occurs in the middle of a fiscal quarter, the grant will be prorated to reflect time worked that quarter; vesting commencement aligned to payroll."
4) No tax gross-up language anywhere; treat relocation stipend as a taxable reimbursement.
5) Add standard Redwood confidentiality and IP assignment language (copy from master template link in People docs).

Cc'ing Marissa — need HR to confirm any legal constraints on pro-rated equity and whether the 9-month relocation window is standard.

Aditya

Hi Aditya / Priyom,

Thank you — I appreciate the flexibility on start dates. 06/01 would be preferable if possible because I have a project handover to complete. A few quick clarifications from my side: 
- If I start remotely and relocate later, does the relocation stipend require receipts or is it a lump sum?
- For the signing bonus repayment, can the pro rata be monthly instead of "full" if I depart within 12 months? I just want the language to be clear.
- Regarding equity vesting, I wanted to confirm whether the 1-year cliff applies from the payroll start date or from "first day worked" (I may start remotely a week before my first payroll date).

Happy to sign once these are clarified. I can do 06/01 start if that works for Redwood. Looking forward to joining the team.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Elena Rossi — comp band and start options

Thanks for the notes — copied answers and next steps below.

1) Start date: We can support 2026-06-01. Please mark preferred start as 05/10 with candidate flexibility recorded in Greenhouse. I'll update the offer template.
2) Relocation stipend: We treat the $6,000 stipend as taxable and pay on submission of receipts; however we can make a one-time lump sum payout if candidate prefers (tax language included). We do not provide tax gross-up.
3) Signing bonus clawback: HR will use a 12-month prorated repayment schedule (monthly pro rata) in the agreement — I'll update clause.
4) Vesting commencement: Standard is payroll start date for equity paperwork. If there is a day-one remote orientation before payroll, we'll note "vesting commencement aligned to payroll" to avoid ambiguity.
5) Legal on pro-rated grant at mid-quarter: People confirms that our comp system supports prorated grants if we explicitly state the proration method; will add sample formula.

Next steps: Marissa will post updated offer doc and DocuSign link by EOD 3/16. Priyom — please confirm Elena's preferred payout method for relocation when you follow up. Aditya — please confirm final sign-off once you review the updated language.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
HR Business Partner | Redwood Inference
